scope: Kit originals read on this PC only to classify them; classes, counts, shares and column ordinals only.
No runtime, no code change, no provider call.

read: CSVs whole with the standard csv reader (sniffed delimiter); the workbook's 12 sheets whole from their sheet
XML (all 12 readable this way; the product exports 10, S9.4a).
lonLatPair: Two different columns, every filled value numeric, one all in -180..180 and the other all in -90..90;
header names tested for lon, lng, longitude and lat, latitude words.
method.projectedPair: Two numeric columns, every absolute value 1000 or more, with x, y, easting or northing names.
method.geometryText: Half or more of a column's text cells start as WKT (SRID, Z, M allowed) or a GeoJSON object.
addressText: Mean text length 12 or more with address words or postcode shapes and commas each in 30% or more of
cells, or an address-style header name over long text.
keyMatch: Distinct values of 3 or more characters (plain 1..n integer runs excluded) against every column of every
other kit table, the gml:id and name, value and attribute texts of both models, and the whole text of both
PDFs and the DOCX; a match needs 50% or more of the column's distinct values. Rasters hold no keys or text.

words: No kit table holds a coordinate pair, a projected x and y pair, WKT or GeoJSON text, an address, or a
column whose values are keys of another kit file. Two tables name places by text or code only, and no kit
file gives those places a position, so nothing in them can be drawn or placed from the kit.
forTheRunner: The officer's one table confirmation reads field meanings; it cannot put any kit table on the map.
None of the four tables is in a drawable form for Done point 3, and point 4 finds no shared key, address
or place between a table and another kit file.

rangeNotes: In all 15 tables no numeric column has every absolute value 1000 or more: no projected pair, whatever names.
One numeric column in all 15 lies wholly in the latitude range (csv-small-3 column 6, one repeated value):
no longitude and latitude pair, whatever names. The workbook's fractional columns all exceed -180..180.
No CSV header carries a longitude, latitude, x, y, easting or northing word; the sheets have no header names.

class: Column 1 is a plain 1..n row number under a settlement-word header; column 2 holds unique letter-only
Column 1 holds unique three-letter upper-case codes, 19% of rows in a 50-entry list of common country
codes; column 2 holds unique names, one per row.

item2.result: not_applicable: no table has a positioned place (coordinates, projected pair, geometry text, address)
placesWithoutPosition: not_placeable_from_kit: a name or code has no position until a gazetteer or boundary layer joins it, and
no kit file holds matching keys (best share 0.03). No geocoder was run and no position is assumed.
item2.otherFootprints: S9.4a stands: rasters over 500 km from both models; medium model 50 to 500 km from the area.

check: Items 1 and 2 answered for csv-small-1, csv-small-2, csv-small-3 and all 12 workbook sheets by ordinal.
